newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady-off $2/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady-off $2/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were mostly $1.00 per cwt lower; dressed basis very uneven, ranging from near steady for some mostly Choice cattle in the Eastern area, to $2.00 lower in the far West. Confirmed - 25,000 Last Week - 28,400 Last Year - 48,000
Wk To Date- 31,000 Sm Pd Lst W - 37,600 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 56,800

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs - 62.00-64.00; dressed basis 100.00-102.00, those over 101.00 mostly Choice, those under 101.00 usually in far Western area. ( weighted average 101.26).

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1225 lbs - 62.00-64.00; dressed basis 100.00-102.00, those over 101.00 mostly Choice, those under 101.00 usually in far West. ( weighted average 101.05).

Demand and seller interest was uneven, but good on average. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
